effort_banners.low: Effort: LOW. Keep it short and mechanical. Do only what the brief says; do not explore beyond it.
effort_banners.medium: Effort: MEDIUM. Think through the edge cases before you act.
effort_banners.high: Effort: HIGH. Think hard. List the possible explanations or options before you pick one.
effort_banners.xhigh: Effort: XHIGH. Think very hard. Look at many options before you narrow down, and say why you dropped the others.
effort_banners.max: Effort: MAX. Ultrathink. Try every option. Before you decide, make the strongest case for the opposite answer.
